pisos-vs-distancia.html.title: Housing Cost vs. Commute · Barcelona
pisos-vs-distancia.html.description: Map and plot housing prices across the 92 municipalities within 30 km of Barcelona — and the city's 73 neighbourhoods — against real door-to-door public transport time, driving time or straight-line distance to any point you pick. Includes household income, age and service frequency per area. Official data, nothing estimated.

transporte-publico.html.title: Where Can I Live? · Barcelona Public Transport
transporte-publico.html.description: Set your commute rules — how far you'll walk, where you must get to and in how long — and get back the cheapest places that meet them, ranked by €/m². One map of 164 zones: 91 municipalities plus Barcelona broken down into its 73 neighbourhoods, coloured by price, with the rail, metro, tram and bus network drawn on top. Door-to-door times routed over official timetables; click any point on the map for an estimate.

sp500-rendimientos.html.title: Does the S&P 500 Really Return 10 % a Year?
sp500-rendimientos.html.description: 155 years of monthly data put the claim to the test: every calendar year, every rolling window, lump sum or monthly contributions, inflation stripped out and costs subtracted — next to gold, US housing and world equities. Shiller, FRED, Eurostat and S&P sources, nothing estimated.
